summary_rationale: Kross Limited is a credible, backward-integrated Tier-1 manufacturer of forged M&HCV/tractor components and single-piece extruded trailer axles (scaling trailer systems to ~43%–49% of revenue, with Q2 FY27 sales +80% YoY to Rs 235 Cr and PAT +143% YoY to Rs 20 Cr, backed by an IND A / Stable rating). However, it fails the hurdle for a structural compounder because of acute cyclicality (flat Rs 620 Cr sales in FY25), high top-5 customer concentration (~66%–71%), severe working capital stretch (working capital days expanded from 30 in FY24 to 124 in FY26; debtor days 107), weak 3-year CFO/PAT conversion (30.4% over FY24–FY26; negative FCF of -Rs 111 Cr cumulative), ROCE halving from 33% (FY24) to 16% (FY26), and renewed borrowing (Rs 119 Cr in Sep 2026) plus Oct 2026 equity dilution (Rs 63.6 Cr preferential issue) to fund its Rs 167 Cr seamless tube plant ahead of FY28 commercialization.
